'''Metarra din Junalle''' is an apprentice to one of the [[Sea Folk]] [[Windfinder]]s. 

== Appearance ==
She has big eyes{{ref/book|8|2}}. She is plump but solid{{ref/book|8|5}}. She has no nose ring yet and has one earring in the left ear and three in the right.

==Strength==
During the use of the [[Bowl of the Winds]] Metarra is described as strong as [[Elayne Trakand]] in the [[One Power]]{{ref/book|8|2}}. But it is not clear if the comparison is with Elayne's potential or actual strength.

Also the WoTC does not clarify it, in fact in Metarra's entry there we can read "Her strength level was {{opsl|15}}, roughly equal to Elayne and Egwene". But we know firstly that both of them have a potential at level {{opsl|14}} and secondly that Egwene was forced and so reached it, but instead Elayne has to reach her full potential yet.

== Activities ==
She [[Traveling|Travels]] with the the rest of the group led by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and Elayne Trakand from [[Ebou Dar]] to the [[Kin]]'s [[farm]] with the Bowl of the Winds. Due to her great strength in the One Power, she is part of the thirteen women who [[link]] and channel into the Bowl of the Winds to change the weather{{ref/book|8|5}}.

After it Metarra reaches [[Caemlyn]]{{ref/book|8|20}}, following Elayne and Nynaeve, along the other Windfinders{{ref/book|8|28}}. In the capital city of Andor, for a while Metarra is instructed by the Aes Sedai along her fellow companions{{ref/book|9|11}}. Some time later, when Zaida leaves Caemlyn, Metarra goes with her{{ref/book|11|15}}.
